test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: A and B can separately finish a work in 15 and 20 days, respectively. A starts the work and B joins him from the fifth day. How much time will it take to finish the complete work?
solution:
**Given:**

A = 15 days

B = 20 days

B joins A on the 5th day

**Formula used:**

Work done = time taken x efficiency

efficiency = 1/time taken

**Solution:**

Work done by A in one day = 1/15

Work done by A in 4 days = 4 x 1/15 = 4/15

Work done by A & B in one day = 1/15 + 1/20 = 7/60

Work done on 5th day = 4/15 + 7/60 = 23/60

Now, let m = the number of days A & B must work together,

4/15 + (7/60)m = 1

16 + 7m = 60

7m = 44

m = 44/7 = 6(2)/(7)

**So, total days, required = work done by only A + workdone bty both **

**⇒ 4 + 6**(2)/(7)** = 10**(2)/(7)** days.**
